mapper.select: SELECT cmp11_mail_role_id AS mail_role_id , cmp11_mail_book_id AS mail_book_id , cmp11_person_id AS person_id , org00_kor_nm AS org_name , f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, emp03_trans_date::date, 'title_nm') AS title_name , emp01_emp_no AS emp_no , emp01_kor_nm AS emp_kor_name FROM cmp11_mail_role INNER JOIN emp01_person ON cmp11_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN org00_org_info ON emp03_org_code_id = org00_org_code_id WHERE cmp11_mail_book_id = #{mailBookId} AND cmp11_mail_book_id IN ( SELECT cmp10_mail_book_id FROM cmp10_mail_book WHERE cmp10_company_id = #{companyId} ) AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND x.emp03_trans_date <= f_sysdate() ) AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(org00_mod_date) FROM org00_org_info WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date ) ORDER BY org00_org_cd , f_org_seq(org00_org_code_id, emp03_trans_date, emp01_company_id) , f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpTitleCode', emp03_title_cd) , f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmp11_mail_role (cmp11_mail_role_id, cmp11_mail_book_id, cmp11_person_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{mailBookId}, #{personId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cmp11_mail_role WHERE cmp11_mail_book_id IN ( SELECT cmp10_mail_book_id FROM cmp10_mail_book WHERE cmp10_company_id = #{companyId} ) AND cmp11_mail_role_id IN #{id}
